# Yuva Unstoppable
> Yuva Unstoppable is a premier non-profit organization in India and the US, empowering resilient communities and government schools through digital literacy, sanitation, scholarships, and agroforestry.

## Core Pages
- [Home Page](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/): Introduction to our mission, campaigns, and key partners.
- [Our Story](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/our-story): The history and milestones of Yuva Unstoppable.
- [Our Vision](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/our-vision): Our future goals and alignment with national development priorities.
- [Our People](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/our-people): Our leadership, trustees, and advisory board.
- [Life @ Yuva](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/life-at-yuva): The culture, events, and work environment at Yuva Unstoppable.

## Our Programmes
- [Anganwadi Transformation](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/anganwadi-transformation): Upgrading maternal and early childhood care centers.
- [Scholarships](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/scholarship): Financial support and mentorship for meritorious students from underprivileged backgrounds.
- [Skill & Employability](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/skill-and-employability): Vocational training and livelihood enablement programs.
- [Environment & Climate Action](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/environment-and-climate-action): Supporting environment and farming communities through tree-planting initiatives.
- [School Transformation](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/school-transformation): Enhancing infrastructure, sanitation, and learning aids in government schools.
- [Community Response](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/community-response): Disaster relief, emergency response, clean water, and community welfare initiatives.

## Impact & Transparency
- [Impact Reports](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/impact): Reports measuring our work against UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
- [Alignment with UN SDGs](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/alignment-with-un-sdgs): Our focus on clean water, quality education, and climate action.
- [Annual Reports](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/annual-reports): Publications of our annual financial statements and reviews.
- [Donors & Audit Partners](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/donors-and-audit-partners): CSR donors and audit firms that support accountability and impact.
- [Award Recognition](https://yuvaunstoppable.org/award-recognition): Awards and recognition received by Yuva Unstoppable.
